sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 2001
ORDINANCE
XXIV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance
of
Public Order Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance tray
be called the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come. into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.

No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section
3 of Ordinance XXXI of 1960.‑‑In the
Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred
to as the said Ordinance in section 3.
(a) in subsection (2) for the words District magistrate the words
Zila Nazim shall be substituted.
(b) in subsection (8) for the words District magistrate appearing
twice the words Zila Nazim shall be substituted.
(c) in subsection (10) for the words District magistrate the words
Zila Nazim shall be substituted.
